parameters.help_en:
The cycle type. Valid values:

Month: monthly
Week: weekly
parameters.help_zh:
周期类型。

Month 每月
Week 每周
parameters.name: cycle_type

parameters.help_en:
The cycle time.

If CycleType is set to Month, a number from 1 to 28 is returned, indicating the day of the month. Multiple values are separated by commas (,). The value is 0 if the configuration has not taken effect.
If CycleType is set to Week, a number from 1 to 7 is returned, indicating the day of the week. Multiple values are separated by commas (,). The value is 0 if the configuration has not taken effect
parameters.help_zh:
周期时间。

当CycleType为Month，返回1～28的数字，表示每月几号，用","拼接。配置未生效时为0。
当CycleType为Week，返回1～7的数字，表示每周星期几，用","拼接。配置未生效时为0
parameters.name: cycle_time

parameters.help_en: The start time of the O&M time window. The time is in the HH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 运维时间窗口开始时间，格式为HH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: maintain_start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the O&M time window. The time is in the HH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 运维时间窗口结束时间，格式为HH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: maintain_end_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the configuration takes effect. Valid values:
1: Takes effect.
2: Does not take effect
parameters.name: status
